question: About 85% of the Indian population of colonial India depended on which of the following sector of the economy?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Agriculture**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Agriculture** was the **primary sector **on which about 85% of the Indian population depended during colonial India.
 
• The **agrarian economy **was the backbone of colonial India, with a vast majority of the population engaged in farming and related activities.
